title: Game Master Outputs Configuration
description: List of measurements published to the game master, by Dynawo or by the asset simulator

equipmentId.description: IIDM equipment identifier, null for a purely dynamic model, which is identified by 'model' instead

factor.description: Scaling factor from Dynawo units to raw units (MW, kV, Hz) (value published in raw units). Defaults to 1

simulator.description: Simulator this entry belongs to; the orchestrator only drives the dynawo ones

model.description: Name of the dynamic model, what 'equipmentId' is for IIDM equipment. Required, with 'model_lib', when 'equipmentId' is null

model_lib.description: Which kind of dynamic model it is (e.g. DYNModelOmegaRef), what the pypowsybl element type is for IIDM equipment

then.description: A Dynawo entry is either IIDM equipment (string 'equipmentId') or a purely dynamic model ('model' and 'model_lib')
